verses.en: The proverbs of Solomon. A wise son maketh a glad father: but a foolish son is the heaviness of his mother.
verses.pt: Provérbios de Salomão. Um filho sábio alegra a seu pai; mas um filho insensato é a tristeza de sua mae.
verses.en_web: The proverbs of Solomon. A wise son makes a glad father; but a foolish son brings grief to his mother.
verses.en_bbe: A wise son makes a glad father, but a foolish son is a sorrow to his mother.

verses.en: Treasures of wickedness profit nothing: but righteousness delivereth from death.
verses.pt: Os tesouros da impiedade de nada aproveitam; mas a justiça livra da morte.
verses.en_web: Treasures of wickedness profit nothing, but righteousness delivers from death.
verses.en_bbe: Wealth which comes from sin is of no profit, but righteousness gives salvation from death.

verses.en: The LORD will not suffer the soul of the righteous to famish: but he casteth away the substance of the wicked.
verses.pt: O Senhor não deixa o justo passar fome; mas o desejo dos ímpios ele rechaça.
verses.en_web: Yahweh will not allow the soul of the righteous to go hungry, but he thrusts away the desire of the wicked.
verses.en_bbe: The Lord will not let the upright be in need of food, but he puts far from him the desire of the evil-doers.

verses.en: He becometh poor that dealeth with a slack hand: but the hand of the diligent maketh rich.
verses.pt: O que trabalha com mão remissa empobrece; mas a mão do diligente enriquece.
verses.en_web: He becomes poor who works with a lazy hand, but the hand of the diligent brings wealth.
verses.en_bbe: He who is slow in his work becomes poor, but the hand of the ready worker gets in wealth.

verses.en: He that gathereth in summer is a wise son: but he that sleepeth in harvest is a son that causeth shame.
verses.pt: O que ajunta no verão é filho prudente; mas o que dorme na sega é filho que envergonha.
verses.en_web: He who gathers in summer is a wise son, but he who sleeps during the harvest is a son who causes shame.
verses.en_bbe: He who in summer gets together his store is a son who does wisely; but he who takes his rest when the grain is being cut is a son causing shame.

verses.en: Blessings are upon the head of the just: but violence covereth the mouth of the wicked.
verses.pt: Bênçãos caem sobre a cabeça do justo; porém a boca dos ímpios esconde a violência.
verses.en_web: Blessings are on the head of the righteous, but violence covers the mouth of the wicked.
verses.en_bbe: Blessings are on the head of the upright, but the face of sinners will be covered with sorrow.

verses.en: The memory of the just is blessed: but the name of the wicked shall rot.
verses.pt: A memória do justo é abençoada; mas o nome dos ímpios apodrecerá.
verses.en_web: The memory of the righteous is blessed, but the name of the wicked will rot.
verses.en_bbe: The memory of the upright is a blessing, but the name of the evil-doer will be turned to dust.

verses.en: The wise in heart will receive commandments: but a prating fool shall fall.
verses.pt: O sábio de coração aceita os mandamentos; mas o insensato palra dor cairá.
verses.en_web: The wise in heart accept commandments, but a chattering fool will fall.
verses.en_bbe: The wise-hearted man will let himself be ruled, but the man whose talk is foolish will have a fall.

verses.en: He that walketh uprightly walketh surely: but he that perverteth his ways shall be known.
verses.pt: Quem anda em integridade anda seguro; mas o que perverte os seus caminhos será conhecido.
verses.en_web: He who walks blamelessly walks surely, but he who perverts his ways will be found out.
verses.en_bbe: He whose ways are upright will go safely, but he whose ways are twisted will be made low.

verses.en: He that winketh with the eye causeth sorrow: but a prating fool shall fall.
verses.pt: O que acena com os olhos dá dores; e o insensato palrador cairá.
verses.en_web: One winking with the eye causes sorrow, but a chattering fool will fall.
verses.en_bbe: He who makes signs with his eyes is a cause of trouble, but he who makes a man see his errors is a cause of peace.

verses.en: The mouth of a righteous man is a well of life: but violence covereth the mouth of the wicked.
verses.pt: A boca do justo é manancial de vida, porém a boca dos ímpios esconde a violência.
verses.en_web: The mouth of the righteous is a spring of life, but violence covers the mouth of the wicked.
verses.en_bbe: The mouth of the upright man is a fountain of life, but the mouth of the evil-doer is a bitter cup.

verses.en: Hatred stirreth up strifes: but love covereth all sins.
verses.pt: O ódio excita contendas; mas o amor cobre todas as transgressões.
verses.en_web: Hatred stirs up strife, but love covers all wrongs.
verses.en_bbe: Hate is a cause of violent acts, but all errors are covered up by love.

verses.en: In the lips of him that hath understanding wisdom is found: but a rod is for the back of him that is void of understanding.
verses.pt: Nos lábios do entendido se acha a sabedoria; mas a vara é para as costas do que é falto de entendimento.
verses.en_web: Wisdom is found on the lips of him who has discernment, but a rod is for the back of him who is void of understanding.
verses.en_bbe: In the lips of him who has knowledge wisdom is seen; but a rod is ready for the back of him who is without sense.

verses.en: Wise men lay up knowledge: but the mouth of the foolish is near destruction.
verses.pt: Os sábios entesouram o conhecimento; porém a boca do insensato é uma destruição iminente.
verses.en_web: Wise men lay up knowledge, but the mouth of the foolish is near ruin.
verses.en_bbe: Knowledge is stored up by the wise, but the mouth of the foolish man is a destruction which is near.

verses.en: The rich man’s wealth is his strong city: the destruction of the poor is their poverty.
verses.pt: Os bens do rico são a sua cidade forte; a ruína dos pobres é a sua pobreza.
verses.en_web: The rich man’s wealth is his strong city. The destruction of the poor is their poverty.
verses.en_bbe: The property of the man of wealth is his strong town: the poor man's need is his destruction.

verses.en: The labour of the righteous tendeth to life: the fruit of the wicked to sin.
verses.pt: O trabalho do justo conduz à vida; a renda do ímpio, para o pecado.
verses.en_web: The labor of the righteous leads to life. The increase of the wicked leads to sin.
verses.en_bbe: The work of the upright gives life: the increase of the evil-doer is a cause of sin.

verses.en: He is in the way of life that keepeth instruction: but he that refuseth reproof erreth.
verses.pt: O que atende à instrução está na vereda da vida; mas o que rejeita a repreensão anda errado.
verses.en_web: He is in the way of life who heeds correction, but he who forsakes reproof leads others astray.
verses.en_bbe: He who takes note of teaching is a way of life, but he who gives up training is a cause of error.

verses.en: He that hideth hatred with lying lips, and he that uttereth a slander, is a fool.
verses.pt: O que encobre o ódio tem lábios falsos; e o que espalha a calúnia é um insensato.
verses.en_web: He who hides hatred has lying lips. He who utters a slander is a fool.
verses.en_bbe: Hate is covered up by the lips of the upright man, but he who lets out evil about another is foolish.

verses.en: In the multitude of words there wanteth not sin: but he that refraineth his lips is wise.
verses.pt: Na multidão de palavras não falta transgressão; mas o que refreia os seus lábios é prudente.
verses.en_web: In the multitude of words there is no lack of disobedience, but he who restrains his lips does wisely.
verses.en_bbe: Where there is much talk there will be no end to sin, but he who keeps his mouth shut does wisely.

verses.en: The tongue of the just is as choice silver: the heart of the wicked is little worth.
verses.pt: A língua do justo é prata escolhida; o coração dos ímpios é de pouco valor.
verses.en_web: The tongue of the righteous is like choice silver. The heart of the wicked is of little worth.
verses.en_bbe: The tongue of the upright man is like tested silver: the heart of the evil-doer is of little value.

verses.en: The lips of the righteous feed many: but fools die for want of wisdom.
verses.pt: Os lábios do justo apascentam a muitos; mas os insensatos, por falta de entendimento, morrem.
verses.en_web: The lips of the righteous feed many, but the foolish die for lack of understanding.
verses.en_bbe: The lips of the upright man give food to men, but the foolish come to death for need of sense.

verses.en: The blessing of the LORD, it maketh rich, and he addeth no sorrow with it.
verses.pt: A bênção do Senhor é que enriquece; e ele não a faz seguir de dor alguma.
verses.en_web: Yahweh’s blessing brings wealth, and he adds no trouble to it.
verses.en_bbe: The blessing of the Lord gives wealth: hard work makes it no greater.

verses.en: It is as sport to a fool to do mischief: but a man of understanding hath wisdom.
verses.pt: E um divertimento para o insensato o praticar a iniqüidade; mas a conduta sábia é o prazer do homem entendido.
verses.en_web: It is a fool’s pleasure to do wickedness, but wisdom is a man of understanding’s pleasure.
verses.en_bbe: It is sport to the foolish man to do evil, but the man of good sense takes delight in wisdom.

verses.en: The fear of the wicked, it shall come upon him: but the desire of the righteous shall be granted.
verses.pt: O que o ímpio teme, isso virá sobre ele; mas aos justos se lhes concederá o seu desejo.
verses.en_web: What the wicked fear, will overtake them, but the desire of the righteous will be granted.
verses.en_bbe: The thing feared by the evil-doer will come to him, but the upright man will get his desire.

verses.en: As the whirlwind passeth, so is the wicked no more: but the righteous is an everlasting foundation.
verses.pt: Como passa a tempestade, assim desaparece o impio; mas o justo tem fundamentos eternos.
verses.en_web: When the whirlwind passes, the wicked is no more; but the righteous stand firm forever.
verses.en_bbe: When the storm-wind is past, the sinner is seen no longer, but the upright man is safe for ever.

verses.en: As vinegar to the teeth, and as smoke to the eyes, so is the sluggard to them that send him.
verses.pt: Como vinagre para os dentes, como fumaça para os olhos, assim é o preguiçoso para aqueles que o mandam.
verses.en_web: As vinegar to the teeth, and as smoke to the eyes, so is the sluggard to those who send him.
verses.en_bbe: Like acid drink to the teeth and as smoke to the eyes, so is the hater of work to those who send him.

verses.en: The fear of the LORD prolongeth days: but the years of the wicked shall be shortened.
verses.pt: O temor do Senhor aumenta os dias; mas os anos os impios serão abreviados.
verses.en_web: The fear of Yahweh prolongs days, but the years of the wicked shall be shortened.
verses.en_bbe: The fear of the Lord gives long life, but the years of the evil-doer will be cut short.

verses.en: The hope of the righteous shall be gladness: but the expectation of the wicked shall perish.
verses.pt: A esperança dos justos é alegria; mas a expectação dos ímpios perecerá.
verses.en_web: The prospect of the righteous is joy, but the hope of the wicked will perish.
verses.en_bbe: The hope of the upright man will give joy, but the waiting of the evil-doer will have its end in sorrow.

verses.en: The way of the LORD is strength to the upright: but destruction shall be to the workers of iniquity.
verses.pt: O caminho do Senhor é fortaleza para os retos; mas é destruição para os que praticam a iniqüidade.
verses.en_web: The way of Yahweh is a stronghold to the upright, but it is a destruction to the workers of iniquity.
verses.en_bbe: The way of the Lord is a strong tower for the upright man, but destruction to the workers of evil.

verses.en: The righteous shall never be removed: but the wicked shall not inhabit the earth.
verses.pt: O justo nunca será abalado; mas os ímpios não habitarão a terra.
verses.en_web: The righteous will never be removed, but the wicked will not dwell in the land.
verses.en_bbe: The upright man will never be moved, but evil-doers will not have a safe resting-place in the land.

verses.en: The mouth of the just bringeth forth wisdom: but the froward tongue shall be cut out.
verses.pt: A boca do justo produz sabedoria; porém a língua perversa será desarraigada.
verses.en_web: The mouth of the righteous produces wisdom, but the perverse tongue will be cut off.
verses.en_bbe: The mouth of the upright man is budding with wisdom, but the twisted tongue will be cut off.

verses.en: The lips of the righteous know what is acceptable: but the mouth of the wicked speaketh frowardness.
verses.pt: Os lábios do justo sabem o que agrada; porém a boca dos ímpios fala perversidades.
verses.en_web: The lips of the righteous know what is acceptable, but the mouth of the wicked is perverse.
verses.en_bbe: The lips of the upright man have knowledge of what is pleasing, but twisted are the mouths of evil-doers.
